A2AAgent.Name: Contoso Research Agent
A2AAgent.Description: Answers questions on demand and produces long-running market research reports. Exposed over the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.

Skills.Name: Quick answer
Skills.Description: Answers a question immediately in a single turn. Returns a Message, not a Task.
Examples: Summarize the A2A protocol in two sentences.

Skills.Name: Market research report
Skills.Description: Produces a multi-section market research brief. Long-running: returns a Task with progress updates and a streamed artifact.
Examples: Research the market for AI agent interoperability tooling.
Produce a report on enterprise adoption of agent protocols.
